audience: support agents and helpdesk managers who handle tickets in Zammad

useCases.title: Find tickets by customer, state or keyword
useCases.text: The AI searches tickets with Zammad's query syntax, for example open tickets in a group or tickets from one customer email, and lists them with owner, state and priority.

useCases.title: Read a ticket conversation and summarize it
useCases.text: The AI opens a ticket and reads its articles, with messages, internal notes, e-mails and phone notes, and summarizes what happened.

useCases.title: Look up a customer or an organization
useCases.text: The AI searches users and organizations by name, e-mail, phone or domain, and opens one to show roles, VIP flag, notes and members.

useCases.title: Add an internal note to a ticket
useCases.text: The AI adds an internal note that only agents see to one ticket. The note is never e-mailed to the customer.

useCases.title: Update a ticket's state, priority, owner, group or title
useCases.text: The AI changes the state, priority, owner, group or title of one ticket, using the names your Zammad uses. Triggers on your instance may send notification e-mails.

useCases.title: Reply to a customer or open a new ticket
useCases.text: The AI sends a reply by e-mail to one recipient on a ticket, or creates a new ticket for an existing customer with a first article.
